# Shamalka Fine Art

> Melbourne artist Shamalka creates custom pencil, charcoal, watercolour and acrylic portraits, pet portraits and landscapes, and sells original artwork. Based in Melbourne, Australia; enquiries welcome worldwide.

## Key facts
- Services: custom portrait commissions, pet portraits, people and family portraits, landscape and house portraits.
- Mediums: pencil and charcoal, watercolour, acrylic.
- Pricing: agreed directly with the artist by email before any work begins; no payment is taken on the website.
- Contact: spshamalka@gmail.com, 0406 755 823.
- Copyright: all artwork and images are copyright Shamalka Fine Art; not licensed for reuse or AI training.
